extensionDescription.message: Parser for loaded Mapbox Vector Tiles
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and extension manager

clearAll.description: Link that empties the table of captured tiles

trackEmptyResponses.description: Checkbox label; keeps rows for tiles that contain no features

trackOnlySuccessfulResponses.description: Checkbox label; drops rows for failed or cancelled requests

captureBy.description: Label for the dropdown choosing how requests are recognised as tiles

modeAutomatic.description: Capture mode that needs no configuration

modeContentType.description: Capture mode that matches one response content type

modeUrlPattern.description: Capture mode that matches a regular expression against the URL

contentTypeHint.description: Tooltip on the value box while in Content Type mode

urlPatternHint.message: Regular expression matched against the request URL
urlPatternHint.description: Tooltip on the value box while in URL Pattern mode

legendSuccess.description: Legend entry for a tile that loaded and contains features

legendEmpty.description: Legend entry for a tile that loaded but contains no features

legendFailed.description: Legend entry for a request that failed or was cancelled

tilesTableLabel.description: Accessible name of the table of captured tiles

columnBytes.description: Column header: size of the tile in bytes

columnLayers.description: Column header: total number of layers in the tile. Σ means sum/total

columnFeatures.description: Column header: feature count per layer. Σ means sum/total

columnStarted.description: Column header: position of the request in start order

columnEnded.description: Column header: position of the request in completion order

columnTime.description: Column header: how long the request took

loadingTile.description: Shown in the dialog while a tile is being converted to GeoJSON

loadingTileWithSize.description: Shown in the dialog while a large tile is being converted to GeoJSON

errorLoadingTile.description: Error logged when a tile cannot be loaded from the store or the network

warnStoredTileMissing.message: Cannot read the stored tile $TILE$. The tile will be fetched again...
warnStoredTileMissing.description: Warning logged before falling back to refetching a tile over the network

warnUnreadableTile.message: Cannot read a vector tile from the network response for tile $TILE$ (decoded size $SIZE$, expected $EXPECTED$). The request was probably aborted while its body was being read.
warnUnreadableTile.description: Warning logged when a captured response body cannot be decoded

valueUnknown.description: Stands in for a size that could not be determined

usedLibraries.description: Heading in the popup above the list of third party libraries

sourceCode.description: Heading in the popup above the source repository links

originalSource.description: Label in the popup for the repository this extension was forked from
